stem.text: Two cells, each with electromotive force (e.m.f.) $E$, but different internal resistances $r_1$ and $r_2$, are connected in series to a resistor $R$. The reading on the voltmeter is $0\,\text{V}$.

stem.alt: Circuit with two cells, each labelled E and shown in a dashed box with an internal resistance labelled r1 and r2, connected in series to a resistor labelled R, with a voltmeter marked V across the two cells.

stem.text: What is the resistance of R?
